articles.title: French Fry-Sized Fish Conquers a 50-Foot Waterfall!
articles.summary: Tiny shellear fish, no bigger than a French fry, climb a 50-foot waterfall in Africa. They use microscopic hooks on their fins like Velcro. It can take them 10 hours to reach the top!

articles.title: Replicants Fight Back in New Blade Runner 2099 Trailer!
articles.summary: In Blade Runner 2099, replicants—human-like robots—finally rise up against their human rulers. The new trailer shows a futuristic Los Angeles, 50 years after the last movie. Stars Michelle Yeoh!

articles.title: Niall Horan Surprises Off Campus Star with Secret Duet!
articles.summary: Ella Bright, star of Off Campus, had no idea Niall Horan added his voice to her song. The secret duet of "Baby Now That I Found You" is on the new soundtrack. Her reaction was priceless!
